channel.title: The Munsif Daily - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Munsif Daily (munsifdaily.com)

item.title: Trump launches Great American Recovery plan
item.description: US President Donald Trump signed a sweeping executive order launching what he called the Great American Recovery Initiative, a national effort aimed at combating addiction and substance abuse by coordinating federal, state, local, and private-sector resources.

item.title: Chennaiyin FC sign Spanish Forward Inigo Martin ahead of the new season
item.description: Chennaiyin FC have completed the signing of Spanish attacker Inigo Martin, with the 26-year-old set to embark on his first stint in Indian football.

item.title: JCRA assigns landmark ratings to Adani Ports, Adani Green and Adani Energy Solutions
item.description: In a significant milestone for the Adani Group’s global credit journey, Japan Credit Rating Agency (JCRA) has initiated ratings of three Portfolio companies — Adani Ports and SEZ (APSEZ), Adani Green Energy Ltd.

item.title: Karnataka CM inaugurates 17th Bengaluru International Film Festival
item.description: Addressing the gathering, Siddaramaiah said that films should not be limited to entertainment alone but should also work towards correcting social inequalities and addressing the shortcomings of society.

item.title: Gold, silver prices dip after aggressive profit booking from record levels
item.description: Gold and silver prices fell on Friday, after hitting record highs in the previous session as investors booked profits and the US dollar gained strength.

item.title: Trump sues IRS, seeks $10 billion over tax return leak
item.description: President Donald Trump has filed a civil lawsuit against the Internal Revenue Service and the US Treasury Department, seeking at least $10 billion in damages over the unauthorised disclosure of his tax return information by an agency contractor who later pleaded guilty to a felony.

item.title: ‘Where will Hindus go?’: BJP leaders welcome UP Cabinet’s move to rehabilitate refugees
item.description: Senior BJP leaders on Friday welcomed the Uttar Pradesh Cabinet’s decision to approve the permanent rehabilitation of 99 Hindu Bengali families displaced from erstwhile East Pakistan, calling the move humanitarian, nationalistic, and long overdue.

item.title: ED files charge sheet against MP govt official in disproportionate assets case
item.description: The Enforcement Directorate's (ED) Indore Sub Zonal Office has filed a charge sheet against Ashok Sharma before the Special Court for PMLA cases in Madhya Pradesh's Indore, ED officials said.

item.title: Rani Mukerji: Want Adira to always be happy, no matter what she chooses to do
item.description: Bollywood actress Rani Mukerji has opened up about parenting and raising a strong, independent child, saying that she wants her daughter Adira to always be happy, no matter what she chooses to do in her career.

item.title: Anupam Kher offers prayers at Sankat Mochan, Kashi Vishwanath temples in Varanasi
item.description: Veteran actor Anupam Kher visited the holy city of Varanasi, seeking blessings at the iconic Sankat Mochan Temple and the revered Kashi Vishwanath Temple. The actor offered prayers for himself and the well-being of all.
